items.title: Gucci Q2 stabilization: Borsetto/Paparazzo bags drive leather goods back to growth, Padlock bag resale surges on eBay
items.summary: Weekly luxury research note covering Gucci's Q2 2026 results: revenue of EUR 1.41 billion (-2%), beating the -4% consensus forecast. New Borsetto and Paparazzo bags pushed leather goods back into positive territory. The note also flags a 530% resale-price surge for the Padlock bag on eBay as a sign of renewed collector interest, framed as an early stabilization signal after Demna's creative reset. Includes Japan-market commentary relevant to NEA demand recovery.

items.title: ケリング決算とデムナのグッチ、9月に向けたビジョン発信の動き
items.summary: Trade coverage recapping Kering's quarterly results narrative and Demna's creative trajectory at Gucci, situating the brand's ongoing turnaround under CEO Francesca Bellettini and group CEO Luca de Meo. The piece frames investor and market sentiment in Japan as hinging on whether recent product resets (new bag lines, pricing discipline) translate into sustained comparable-sales growth into the autumn selling season.

items.title: 肖战以Gucci全球代言人身份出镜2026秋冬系列广告大片 - Xiao Zhan fronts Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 global campaign
items.summary: Chinese actor Xiao Zhan appears as Gucci global ambassador in the brand's Fall/Winter 2026 ready-to-wear advertising campaign (his eighth Gucci campaign), covering bags, footwear, jewelry and holiday lines with a 'vintage oil painting' aesthetic. The campaign coincides with Demna's first in-person Gucci runway show; related fan/community posts also note the roster spans multiple NEA-relevant faces. High organic reach on Weibo/Sina fan-syndication network, though platform-verified engagement counts were not visible on the page.
